description: Copy a post's current version (caption, media, format, options, series) into a new draft, for the same accounts or others in its workspace. Pass scheduled_at or next_slot=true to give the copy a time, and submit=true to send it for approval. Nothing publishes until a person approves it.

account_ids.description: Accounts from accounts_list. Default: the original's connected accounts.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

next_slot.description: Use each account's next free posting time instead of scheduled_at.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset. Goes out at this time once approved.

submit_if_ready.description: Send it for approval when nothing blocks it; otherwise it stays a draft to fix. One tap for "post it there too".

name: post_duplicate
title: Duplicate a post
